name: update_all_incomplete_recurring_task_instances
description:
Propagate a recurring task's current properties to every incomplete instance of its series.

SCOPE — the affected set is 'incomplete' instances, which is not necessarily the same as 'future' ones. Incomplete may include past-dated instances the user never finished, so the change can reach further back than 'all future instances' suggests. This tool's own name and its upstream description disagree on this point, and the boundary is not verifiable from the schema — so assume the broader reading (every instance not marked complete, past or future) and verify against the actual instance list before acting. Instances already completed are not affected. Confirm with the user that they mean the whole series and not a single occurrence; to change one instance, use the single-task tools (edit_task_title, edit_task_time_estimate, append_task_notes) on that instance's own taskId.

BULK WRITE — REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER CONFIRMATION. One call rewrites many tasks. Note that this schema takes ONLY taskId: it does not enumerate which fields are propagated and does not report the prior values, so the change set is not visible from the call and cannot be reconstructed afterward from this tool alone. Do not call it to discover what it does.

Before calling: apply the intended change to the series task first, then list the affected instances and show the user the series title, the taskId, and how many incomplete instances will be rewritten. State that the action is bulk and that previous values are not recoverable through this skill, then get explicit approval for that specific series. Never infer this from a request to change one occurrence, and never call it on a series the user has not named.

taskId.description: The ID of the recurring task
